description: Greek pair mode: dead-key composition, letter-veto parity, ShortWords el. Draft seeded for issue #42; keys are physical (US-QWERTY base), ';' is the Greek tonos dead key, 'q' renders as the Greek question mark ';'.

cases.name: tonos-composes-einai
cases.note: Tonos dead key attaches to the next base char, NFC gives U+03AF. The macOS letter veto passes because CONVERTED is all letters even though typed contains ';' — Windows needs this parity.

cases.name: tonos-composes-logos-final-sigma
cases.note: Final sigma ς lives on the W key.

cases.name: trailing-tonos-stays-spacing
cases.note: Conversion-only: a dead-key accent with no following base char stays as the spacing char (U+0384).

cases.name: tonos-unit-iota
cases.note: Conversion-only: composition unit, NFC precomposes to U+03AF (length 1).

cases.name: greek-question-mark-literal-tail
cases.note: Conversion-only: Q renders the Greek question mark ';' — a legit literal tail of correct Greek, to be split as trailing punctuation by the caller, never treated as a dead key.

cases.name: accentless-greek-undecided-today
cases.note: Chat-style Greek without tonos: the system speller rejects it, so today this stays undecided. A future el frequency pack (tonos-stripped lookup, positive signal only) would flip this to switchToConverted; output keeps exactly what the user typed.

cases.name: ru-image-of-greek
cases.note: The ';' key is a plain letter «ж» on ЙЦУКЕН — no dead key on the source side.

cases.name: shortwords-el-converts
cases.note: 2-letter path: θα is in ShortWords el, 'ua' is not a listed en word — positive frequency signal, no dictionary involved.

cases.name: shortwords-frequent-collision-keeps
cases.note: το↔to: both frequent — the symmetric gate declines auto-conversion in both directions (precision over recall; the manual trigger still works).

cases.name: shortwords-ru-en-unchanged
cases.note: Regression guard: issue #22 behavior for the existing ru↔en pair must stay byte-identical.
